summary: Retest of AUTO-FIT fix in ThermalLabel.jsx after E1 changed the final pass to measure scrollHeight at the exact width that stays applied and derive s = OH/scrollHeight without altering width afterwards. All 6 combinations (3 sizes x 2 products) now PASS the no-clip + fill>=96% criteria. VALIDADE and ALÉRGICOS styles remain correct. Print-current and print-batch (2+3=5 pages) also verified with scale transform applied.
critical_code_review_comments: ThermalLabel.jsx auto-fit is now correct: final pass measures scrollHeight at applied width and sets scale = OH/scrollHeight, guaranteeing height*scale == OH. Consider clamping s within a small epsilon of 1 if desired to avoid over-scaling small content, but functionally not needed.

Print-current with qty=1 => #print-root .label-page count=1 with matrix scale != none. Print-batch with 2 Molho + 3 Brioche in queue => count=5 with scale applied.
rca of the issue: Previous bug (iteration 4) was that the final pass recomputed s = OH/scrollHeight but then altered width to OW/s, which triggered a re-wrap and changed scrollHeight while the just-computed s remained applied — producing scale > 1 with overflow. Fix (iteration 5): measure scrollHeight at the width that will REMAIN applied and derive s from that height without further width mutation, ensuring height*scale == OH exactly. Verified: no clip and fill>=99% across all 6 combos.
